result.rationale: 文章は全体的に組織化されており、主張が明確で、個人的な経験を用いて説明しています。しかし、文法や構文の誤りが見られ、表現の多様性が不足しています。

claims.feature: 明確な主張と個人的な経験の使用
claims.support_explanation: 主張が明確で、具体的な例が提供されている
claims.limits: 他の観点の誤りが全体の評価を引き下げている可能性がある

evidence.text: Churchill statement is right because failing in life is part of succeeding.

My example is when i got pregnant my junior year and when I found out i just wanted to drop out because I was still a kid myself and I kept thinking how people would look at me or what would they say, but I already had an idea.

Here I am now my senior year, eight more months until I graduate and I'm proud of myself because I am a mother now and I'm still going to school, I didnt let that stop me from getting my education and I'm planning to go to college too because all I want is the best for my son and myself; its not me I have to think about now, I have another responsibility to look after for.

claims.support_explanation: 誤りが頻繁に見られる
claims.limits: 誤りの頻度が全体の評価に影響する

evidence.text: Those obsticals you go through in life are part of who you become and how you handle those obsticals.

My example is when i got pregnant my junior year and when I found out i just wanted to drop out because I was still a kid myself and I kept thinking how people would look at me or what would they say, but I already had an idea.
Of course a lot of friends stopped talking to me but that just proves who's there for you and who's not.

claims.support_explanation: 表現が限定的で、より複雑な単語やフレーズの使用が少ない

My parents didnt even support me so what motivation did I have?

claims.limits: 慣用句や熟語の使用が全体の評価に影響する
